I will not buy chemical fertilizer or irrigate, because our crop mostly depends on the rains and I must save money, but I can use some family labor and a little manure if I have it. Since nuts are a cash crop here, I will spray if pests become a problem, and I will rely mostly on my usual planting material rather than improved seed.
